description:
Enrolling adds five tools: three for the catalog — what's offered, how to sign up for a service, and runnable code examples for calling it — and two for the docs, listing the available topics and reading any topic as markdown.

No credentials required. This is the anonymous surface, so every tool answers from public catalog and documentation data.

Reached through the UnitySVC MCP gateway, so there's no separate server to add to your client configuration: one endpoint, and your enrollments decide what appears.
name: unitysvc-mcp
summary: The UnitySVC marketplace and platform docs, as MCP tools. Browse what's offered, learn how to call it, and read the documentation without leaving your AI client.
